verdict.rationale: Motion's meeting templates support configurable 'reminders' alongside durations and pre-meeting questions, implying some automated reminder capability tied to bookings, but there is no evidence of SMS reminders, multi-step follow-up sequences, or any explicit no-show-reduction framing. missing for 10: SMS reminder channel, explicit follow-up sequence automation, no-show reduction metrics/claims, and independent confirmation the reminders actually fire around bookings.
